Proceedings of the 1st IEEE/ACM International Workshop on Methodological Issues with Empirical Studies in Software Engineering (WSESE '24).
read_at_primary.licence: CC BY 4.0 (declared on the arXiv HTML rendering)
read_at_primary.why: This is the paper Session 87 quoted when it filed S87.PASSIVEVOICE. Tonight read the rest of it. Section 2.1 names Krisch & Houdek (2015) and states their finding; section 4 reports that the original experiment's one significant result does not survive the reanalysis.

read_at_primary.citation: Femmer, H., Kučera, J. & Vetrò, A. (2014). On the Impact of Passive Voice Requirements on Domain Modelling. ESEM '14, 21:1–21:4. ACM.
read_at_primary.licence: ACM copyright; the PDF's own notice grants copying for personal or classroom use only. NOT redistributable from here.
read_at_primary.why: One of the three works S87.PASSIVEVOICE named. It is the 'Femmer et al., 2014' of Frattini's parenthesis, confirmed against Frattini's own reference list. It is a controlled experiment with 15 students over 7 requirements. It contains no detector, no corpus and no rate.
